# Terraform files

Follow `skills/terraform-module-design/SKILL.md` when this file is a module, and `skills/terraform-plan-review/SKILL.md` before an apply. Keep state remote and locked. Follow `skills/terraform-state-backends/SKILL.md`. The root configures the provider with OIDC. Follow `skills/principle-no-static-credentials/SKILL.md` and `skills/principle-change-safety/SKILL.md`.
